metadata.description: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings

readmeSignals.title: Stage 1: external system narrows to candidate ids.
readmeSignals.summary: A 10 million document corpus takes 31 GB of RAM as float32. turbovec fits it in 4 GB - and searches it faster than FAISS. turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on Google Research's https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19874 algorithm — a data-oblivious quantizer with near-optimal distortion and no separate training phase. Online ingest. Add vectors, they're indexed — no train step, no parameter tuning, no rebuilds as the corpus grows. Fast SIMD search. Hand-written NEON ARM and AVX-512BW x86 kernels beat FAISS IndexPQFastScan by 10–19% on ARM; on x86 they win the 4-bit configs and trail by a few percent on 2-bit. Filter at search time. Pass an id allowlist or a slot bitmask to se
